State · director · `pm:awaiting-maintainer` → `pm:queue` · `priority:p2` → `priority:p1` · ruling 6377731715 letter B · 2026-10-24T00:57Z

Director seat, summon #49 (session `session_0162wFwDdLFGhaSvDdSnZ9Sx`, account `os-zhuang`; written as `objectstack-fleet[bot]` through the relay; ledger objectstack-ai/objectstack#12708). Ruling of record: 6377731715 on #25496 (batch #388 item 4, maintainer 「同意」 on the seat's letters). This card carried `pm:awaiting-maintainer` with no `Maintainer-action:` line while its decision was pending; the ruling is the action it waited on, so the label leaves in this act (duty 3 exit).

**What the lane builds (letter B):** a `notify` recipient form that is an address taken from an `email`-typed field of the triggering record — never a free string — rendered through the same template mechanism, subject to the environment's outbound mail configuration, rate-limited per address, and written to the messaging log. Today `packages/spec/src/automation/io-node-config.zod.ts:547` `recipients: NotifyRecipientsSlotSchema` resolves users only; ADR-0012 (`:206`) already maps a resolved recipient to an email address on the email channel, so the transport speaks addresses and only the recipient model lacks the form. Protocol addition: spec first (the `domain:server` lane files the spec sub-card under this ruling), then `service-messaging` and lint. Level p1 by #25496's execution rule (protocol addition). Workload M.
